standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: So today we have a question for listeners, and it is: what’s your favourite room, and why?
entries.zh: 所以今天我们有一个问题要问听众：你最喜欢的房间是哪个，为什么？

entries.en: Our first caller is … hello.
entries.zh: 我们的第一位来电者是……你好。

entries.en: What’s your name?
entries.zh: 你叫什么名字？

entries.en: Hi there! My name’s Jo.
entries.zh: 你好！我叫乔。

entries.en: OK Jo, so tell us, what’s your favourite room?
entries.zh: 好的乔，跟大家说说，你最喜欢的房间是什么？

entries.en: It’s my grandfather’s playroom.
entries.zh: 是我祖父的游戏室。

entries.en: Your grandfather’s got a playroom? Really?
entries.zh: 你祖父有个游戏室？真的吗？

entries.en: Yeah.
entries.zh: 是啊。

entries.en: It’s the room with his model trains.
entries.zh: 就是放他的火车模型的那间屋。

entries.en: My grandad still lives in the house he lived in when he was a boy.
entries.zh: 我爷爷至今还住在他小时候住的那栋房子里。

entries.en: And he has a little room with his trains.
entries.zh: 他有一间小屋子放他的火车。

entries.en: I love looking at his trains.
entries.zh: 我喜欢看他的火车。

entries.en: OK. And why is it special for you?
entries.zh: 好的。那这间房对你为什么特别呢？

entries.en: Because he’s so happy there, and we sit and talk, and I feel very relaxed.
entries.zh: 因为他在那儿特别开心，我们会坐着聊天，我感觉非常放松。

entries.en: It’s lovely.
entries.zh: 那种感觉真好。

entries.en: It sounds great, Jo.
entries.zh: 听起来真不错，乔。

entries.en: Thank you.
entries.zh: 谢谢你。

entries.en: Now who’s next? What’s your name and what’s your favourite room?
entries.zh: 下一位是谁？你叫什么名字，最喜欢的房间是什么？

entries.en: Hi.
entries.zh: 你好。

entries.en: I’m Andrew and my favourite room is the music room at my school.
entries.zh: 我是安德鲁，我最喜欢的房间是我们学校的音乐教室。

entries.en: OK, Andrew. And why’s that?
entries.zh: 好的，安德鲁。为什么是它呢？

entries.en: It’s because I love playing the drums, but I can’t have drums at home, so I go into the music room at school and practise there.
entries.zh: 因为我喜欢打架子鼓，但家里放不下鼓，所以我会去学校的音乐教室练习。

entries.en: After school.
entries.zh: 放学以后去。

entries.en: No one cares.
entries.zh: 没人在意。

entries.en: I have a lot of fun!
entries.zh: 我玩得特别开心！

entries.en: Sounds good to me! Thanks, Andrew.
entries.zh: 听起来不错！谢谢安德鲁。

entries.en: Next caller please! Hello!
entries.zh: 下一位来电者请讲话！你好！

entries.en: Hello, I’m Paula.
entries.zh: 你好，我是宝拉。

entries.en: My favourite room is our kitchen at home.
entries.zh: 我最喜欢的房间是我们家的厨房。

entries.en: I love it there because that’s where all of us sit and have our breakfast and dinner, and we’re a family together.
entries.zh: 我喜欢待在那里，因为我们全家都坐在那里吃早餐和晚餐，我们是一家人在一起。

entries.en: It makes me feel really nice and warm.
entries.zh: 它让我感觉特别温暖舒心。

entries.en: Nice and warm. That’s a good reason.
entries.zh: 温暖舒心。这是个好理由。

entries.en: Yeah, and kind of … I don’t know, safe.
entries.zh: 对，还有点……我说不好，很安心。

entries.en: Excellent, Paula, thank you.
entries.zh: 太好了，宝拉，谢谢你。

entries.en: And now we have … hello?
entries.zh: 现在我们有……你好？

entries.en: Hi. Tom here.
entries.zh: 你好，我是汤姆。

entries.en: I don’t know if it’s really my favourite room, but the best room in my whole life was in a hotel.
entries.zh: 我不知道它算不算我真正最喜欢的房间，但我这辈子住过最好的房间是在一家酒店里。

entries.en: Oh right. That’s interesting! Tell us more!
entries.zh: 哦是嘛。有意思！多讲讲！

entries.en: We all went to Brazil last year, and we got to the hotel in Rio de Janeiro very early in the morning and it was still quite dark.
entries.zh: 去年我们全家去了巴西，一大早就到了里约热内卢的酒店，那时天还很黑。

entries.en: But then the day started and I opened the window to see Copacabana beach.
entries.zh: 但白天开始后，我打开窗户就看到了科帕卡巴纳海滩。

entries.en: Brilliant!
entries.zh: 太棒了！

entries.en: I loved that room.
entries.zh: 我爱那间房。

entries.en: We were there for five days and …
entries.zh: 我们在那里住了五天，然后……

entries.en: Thanks, Tom. I’m sorry, there’s no more time.
entries.zh: 谢谢汤姆。抱歉，没时间了。

entries.en: OK, now let’s … .
entries.zh: 好的，现在我们……。
